              G-9 AND G-13 LANDOWNERS’ CLARIFICATION
 IN RESPONSE TO ONCOR AND LCRA’S LIST OF INTERVENORS WHO DID NOT
            FILE TESTIMONY OR A STATEMENT OF POSITION

       The G-9 and G-13 Landowners file this Clarification in Response to Oncor and LCRA’s

List of Intervenors Who Did Not File Testimony or a Statement of Position (Clarification). On

April 6, 2025, Bobby Guthrie filed a request to intervene. Bobby Guthrie was admitted as an

intervenor in SOAH Order No. 5.1 The Bobby Guthrie who filed a request to intervene is the same

Bob Guthrie who is part of the intervenor group, G-9 and G-13 Landowners.2 The G-9 and G-13

Landowners were admitted as parties on April 13, 2026.3 On May 13, 2026, the G-9 and G-13

Landowners filed four pieces of testimony, including testimony from Bob Guthrie.4

       The G-9 and G-13 Landowners file this Response to clarify that Bob Guthrie is an

intervenor in the proceeding, is part of the G-9 and G-13 Landowners and filed testimony on May
